bet.text: It is another full-field cycling game and a drivetrain can only go so fast, so make every other action as fast as possible.

demand.text: Fast cycles: drive under the stage for another lane, score from partly under it without relying on a driver to lower an arm or software to keep the robot from driving into the stage, intake at the source with a wide tolerance, and shoot from far away to cut driving. The team called being able to score in the trap equally important.

auto.text: The team chose a full-width intake to be competitive in auto.

cycle.text: A beam break on pickup rumbles the controller and retracts the intake, which the team says cut cycles by around one second. One aim button aims a feed from behind the midline or a shot from in front; the shoot button checks speed and location first. It shoots on the move around the wing.

endgame.text: Surgical tubing raises the climbing arm. Hooks trap the chain and pull it down while the robot tips toward the stage; then the elevator extends and the launcher tilts forward to score in the trap.

gave_up.text: The two main failures of the flexible intake were sheared bolts that held the axles to the side plates and a snapped deploy chain. Neither was solved during the season.

changed.text: The first launcher had symmetric sides and gave inconsistent shots, some wobbly. High-speed video showed that clean shots touched one roller set first, so one set moved closer to center.
The elevator hex shafts came from an earlier climber, and the top one was reused to tension the new climber's tubing.

outcome.text: 58-10-1 in official play; won the Milstein division; captain of the Milstein alliance on Einstein; ranked 6 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 57.57, Milstein).

solves.text: Take notes across the full width and survive hits against walls and robots

facts.text: Thin 2 in polycarbonate rollers, mostly polycarbonate and 3D printed structure
Dead axles cut short so a hard hit does not bend a shaft inside the roller
A roller flexes more than half its diameter in a bad hit
Chain and a cross shaft inside the frame perimeter tie the left and right sides together, so no rigid cross bar is needed
The axles ended up as spacers of 3/8 in outside diameter, bolted through with a nylock nut; they could be bought at length instead of cutting hex

cost.text: Axle bolts sheared and the deploy chain snapped; neither was solved in season

functions.name: Mecanum centering wheels

solves.text: Center the note without squeezing it, because the launcher accepts a note only in the center of the robot

functions.type: mecanum wheels with funnels in the intake

facts.text: Funnels make the note touch only the wheels that point toward the center, so indexing moves it to the center
Mecanums pointing inward on both sides at once would crush the note sideways

solves.text: Symmetric rollers gave inconsistent shots, some wobbly and some spinning cleanly

facts.text: One set of rollers sits closer to the center than the other, so the note contacts one set first
The same launcher tilts for the amp and, a little further forward, for the trap
Its hex shafts were cut shorter on the robot than the CAD shows

solves.text: The robot has to extend upward to score in the trap

facts.text: Extends upward after the robot has climbed, so the launcher reaches the trap

solves.text: Pull the chain down to the right height while the robot tips inward toward the stage, ready for the trap

facts.text: The chain enters the hook and the bottom of the hook limits its motion
The tubing, not shown in the CAD, is tensioned on a shaft kept from an earlier climber

solves.text: Support one button that aims a feed or a shot depending on field position

facts.text: Simulated particles stand for the robot pose, with random variation for wheel slip and drift; camera views of tag edges score each particle
It gives a pose over the full field, not only when scoring

solves.text: Shoot on the move from around anywhere in the wing

facts.text: Uses goal position and robot speed to find time to goal, checks whether an arm angle lands above or below, and repeats; yaw is solved the same way

functions.name: Belly pan and electronics
functions.type: hand-drilled belly pan with a planned layout

facts.text: The electronics layout was planned in advance; the public CAD leaves the electronics out to reduce lag
Belly pan holes are drilled by hand, not by CNC; the team calls the holes missing from the CAD an oversight

decisions.because: the team wanted a durable intake, and earlier seasons' intakes had been rigid
prototyping showed it was the easiest place to center for the shooter
high-speed video showed that clean shots contacted one set of rollers first

decisions.choice: Short shaft segments in the intake rollers
decisions.because: a full-width hex shaft would end up permanently bent, and short ones let the roller flex and save weight
the bearings were lighter and fit better in the tube plugs

decisions.choice: One driver, with software as the human operator
decisions.because: the team wants only one driver, so mechanisms and software are built to be as drivable as possible
shooting from further away cuts driving time
